decision_cruda.rationale: C564-14 holds 134 t at 12.1 g/t (~52 oz). LH-01 is not back until 12:30 to 14:30. LH-09 is 0.34 h away and can load it at 29.1 t/h in about 4.6 h. The cost is the heading at 1.5 oz/h, about 8 oz including travel. Central trucks have spare capacity (91 vs 78 t/h). E569-10 is low grade (5.8 g/t) and LH-06 is likely back at 11:30. Borrowing LH-08 would net only about +4 oz, so I leave it alone.
